svg.title: AI Horizon system architecture
svg.desc: Client and gameplay systems connect to Amazon Cognito and API Gateway. API Gateway invokes leaderboard and analysis Lambda functions backed by DynamoDB and Amazon Bedrock.
svg.text: Progressive web app, gameplay systems, and serverless AWS backend (us-west-2)
